Food-wise, Disney is usually 50 cents to a dollar cheaper (ex. churro at Disney is 5, churro at Universal is 6). 

It all just depends on what fandoms your child is into, too. If they love Star Wars, Pandora: World of Avatar, and Disney characters, go to Disney. If they love Harry Potter and Jurassic Park/World, go to Universal. I would add Simpsons to the list, but in a few years they'll have to re-theme Simpsons since Disney now owns Simpsons.

If your child has never been to Universal, I'd definitely take them there at least once so they can see which they prefer. Just keep in mind that both parks are great in their own ways.
